mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stamps (id, user_id, place_id, photo_url, visited_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{placeId}, #{photoUrl}, #{visitedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS id, s.place_id AS placeId, p.name AS placeName, p.category AS category, s.photo_url AS photoUrl, s.visited_at AS visitedAt, p.latitude AS latitude, p.longitude AS longitude FROM stamps s LEFT JOIN places p ON s.place_id = p.id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.visited_at DESC
